purpose: Four standalone RTL Bazaarche theme concepts for user selection; concept images are design references, not screenshots of the implementation.

prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE standalone high fidelity desktop e-commerce homepage design screenshot for the Persian RTL store «بازارچه». Landscape canvas about 1536x1024. Show the top 1.5 screens of a credible, implementable storefront, sharp readable UI, carefully aligned Persian typography in Vazir, real photographic product cutouts, prices with comma separators and تومان. It must be an art-directed finished web design, not a wireframe, not a collage, not a laptop/browser mockup. Modern subtle 3-5px corners, excellent spacing, accessible text contrast. Navigation/search/cart and account must be realistic. No English lorem ipsum, no watermarks. Make a polished selection preview that an engineer can implement. Brand text exactly «بازارچه». VARIANT 01: LIGHT MARKETPLACE, inspired by the shopping usability and information density of Digikala, but original Bazaarche branding. White background, energetic red #ef4056 accent and dark graphite type. Dense two-level RTL header: brand at far right, large prominent light-gray search bar in center, login/cart at left; category navigation below. Shallow wide red and soft blush promotional banner with beautifully photographed household and technology products, Persian headline «انتخاب‌های امروز، قیمت‌های بهتر» and compact red CTA. Below: horizontal row of 8 clearly labeled category illustrations. Then a red-framed special-offers section with 5 product cards: headphones, ceramic vase, modern desk lamp, coffee cup, smartwatch. Each card has product title, before/after prices, compact discount percentage flag. Bottom visible editorial sale banners. Bright, familiar, conversion-focused and polished, strongly distinct from a sparse boutique template. Small tasteful label '01' at top-left outside the main navigation if needed.

VARIANT 02: DARK MARKETPLACE. Deep graphite #14181d base, layered charcoal #20262e panels, warm ivory text, muted electric orange #f69652 accent. Dense professional commerce navigation, broad search field, compact category strip. Hero is a 2:1 asymmetric pair: wide premium editorial photography composition of headphones, laptop corner and sculptural desk lamp on a charcoal studio table, modest Persian headline «برای انتخاب‌های دقیق‌تر» with an orange shopping button, and a narrow contrasting deal-of-the-day panel with a smartwatch, discount and price. A horizontal category ribbon, followed by 5 well-aligned product cards on charcoal, product photography on subtly lighter backgrounds, real Persian text and clearly readable prices. Bottom edge a minimal magazine section. Premium and practical night-mode ecommerce; no sci-fi, no neon glow, no fake dashboards, no excessive gradients or rounded capsules. Distinct layout from a Digikala clone. Small tasteful label '02'.

VARIANT 03: EXTREMELY MINIMAL LIGHT EDITORIAL STORE. Soft off-white #f7f5ef, ink-black typography, quiet cobalt #3159d8 used only for small interactions. Right-to-left boutique home goods and everyday objects. Unusually restrained horizontal masthead: elegant Persian Bazaarche wordmark at right, only three navigation links, discreet search and cart at left, fine bottom rule. Large airy hero split into a huge beautifully cropped architectural still-life photograph of an ivory ceramic vase, folded linen and sculptural black reading lamp taking 58% width on the left; confident large Persian headline on the right «کمتر، اما بهتر.» with a short subtitle and tiny underlined shop link; no large colored button. Lots of deliberate negative space. Below hero a small header «اشیای روزمره» aligned with a thin horizontal rule and a refined three-column catalog, 3 large product photographs in warm natural light with simple titles and prices below, no bordered cards. Small collection index numerals. Calm museum/design studio editorial quality, notably more minimal than a normal marketplace. No gradients, no pill badges, no floating shapes. Small tasteful label '03'.
